ingameEffects.label: Idyllic Cadenza (EX Special Attack)
ingameEffects.description:
After entering the Idyllic Cadenza state, Astra Yao increases all squad members' DMG by a percentage and CRIT DMG by a percentage while in the Idyllic Cadenza state, Astra Yao cannot move, but pressing [BASIC] will activate Basic Attack: Interlude, and pressing Dodge will activate a dodge. After triggering a Perfect Dodge, press Basic Attack to activate Basic Attack: Chorus.

While in this state, Astra Yao's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and the DMG she takes is reduced by 40%. After switching to another character, Astra Yao will remain on the field and become Invulnerable. When switching back to her, she will automatically follow up with Special Attack: Windchimes & Oaths. During this state, hold Basic Attack to activate Basic Attack: Finale, exiting the Idyllic Cadenza state, or hold Dodge to exit the Idyllic Cadenza state directly.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: All squad members' CRIT DMG and DMG is increased based on Astra Yao's Special Attack skill level.

ingameEffects.label: Graceful Andante (Core Passive)
ingameEffects.description: During the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other squad members switch in through a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, and when Astra Yao expends Energy to release Tremolo to attack, both Astra Yao and the incoming character's ATK are increased. The increase is equal to 35% of Astra Yao's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 1,200. The effect lasts for 20s and can be extended up to 30s with repeated triggers.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: All squad members' ATK is increased based on Astra Yao's initial ATK.

ingameEffects.label: 12-Tone Equal Temperament (Mindscape Cinema N°1)
ingameEffects.description: When Astra Yao's attack hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 6%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. Upon entering the battlefield, Astra Yao immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. When activating her Ultimate, all squad members gain 1 stack of Song of Protection for 60s. When attacked by an enemy, consume Song of Protection, granting Invulnerability for 1s.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: The target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 6% for 30s, stacking up to 3 times.

ingameEffects.label: Art of Greed (Mindscape Cinema N°2)
ingameEffects.description: The ATK buff from Core Passive: Graceful Andante is further increased by 19%, with an increased maximum of 400. While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other squad members switch in through a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, Astra Yao will additionally follow up with 1 Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters to attack. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: All squad members' ATK is increased based on Astra Yao's initial ATK.

ingameEffects.label: Hair Upon Your Nape (Mindscape Cinema N°4)
ingameEffects.description: After activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate, within 15s, Astra Yao can trigger a Quick Assist even if she does not have Chords. When the attack hits an enemy, the interval for triggering a Quick Assist is reduced to 1s. While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other squad members enter the field via a Quick Assist, they will receive different buffs based on their specialty, and this effect can be triggered once every 3s for the entire squad: Attack: The next Quick Assist heavy attack on an enemy will deal extra DMG equal to 300% of Astra Yao's ATK; Anomaly: The next Quick Assist will have 50% increased Anomaly Buildup; Stun: The next Quick Assist will inflict 50% increased Daze.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This ability is available in the Damage Calculator.

ingameEffects.label: We Are the World (Mindscape Cinema N°6)
ingameEffects.description: While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, the DMG multiplier for Tremolo and Tone Clusters released or followed up with will increase to 200% of the original, and CRIT Rate is increased by 80%. When triggering a Precise Assist, Astra Yao will automatically follow up with the charged 3rd-hit of /bBasic Attack: Capriccio//b, with a 80% increased CRIT Rate. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Astra Yao's updated multipliers are available in the Damage Calculator.

basicAttacks.name: Capriccio (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
Press [BASIC] to activate:

Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.

During the 3rd-hit, hold [BASIC] to charge, drawing enemies in and expanding the attack range for a stronger attack. After using other skills, hold [BASIC] to initiate the 3rd-hit directly.

basicAttacks.name: Interlude (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
While in the /bIdyllic Cadenza//b state, press [BASIC] to activate:

Release /bTremolo//b forward to attack, dealing Ether DMG. A /bQuick Assist//b will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

basicAttacks.name: Chorus (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
While in the /bIdyllic Cadenza//b state, press [BASIC] during a [COUNTER] to activate:

Launch multiple /bTremolo//b attacks at enemies in front, dealing massive Ether DMG. A /bQuick Assist//b will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basicAttacks.name: Finale (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
While in the /bIdyllic Cadenza//b state, hold [BASIC] to activate:

Release /bTremolo//b forward to attack, dealing Ether DMG and exit the /bIdyllic Cadenza//b state.

Upon activation of the skill, it grants the buff from /bCore Passive: Graceful Andante//b.

With enough Energy, consumes Energy to follow up with 1 /bTremolo//b and 3 /bTone Clusters//b. This /bTremolo//b attack released is considered an /bEX Special Attack//b.

dashAttacks.name: Lunar Eclipse Melody (Dash Attack)
dashAttacks.description:
Press [BASIC] during a dodge to activate:

Attack ahead, dealing Ether DMG. When triggered, dragging the joystick allows movement in the corresponding direction.

dodgeCounters.name: Umbrella Waltz (Dodge Counter)
dodgeCounters.description:
Press [BASIC] during a [COUNTER] to activate:

Attack enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssists.name: One Luminous Sky (Quick Assist)
quickAssists.description:
When the active character is launched, press [ASSIST] to activate:

Attack enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: Three Lifetimes of Fate (Assist Follow-Up)
assistFollowup.description:
Press [BASIC] after an /bEvasive Assist//b to activate:

Release an energy beam forward, dealing Ether DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

specialAttacks.name: Windchimes & Oaths (Special Attack)
specialAttacks.description:
Press [SPECIAL] to activate:

Quickly move away, then release /bTremolo//b, dealing Ether DMG, and enter the /bIdyllic Cadenza//b state.

During activation, dragging the joystick enables movement in the direction held. Hold [SPECIAL] to charge during activation, drawing enemies in, and follow up with 1 to 4 /bTremolos//b depending on the charge duration. A /bQuick Assist//b will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy. Character is invulnerable when quickly moving away.

specialAttacks.name: Chord (Special Attack)
specialAttacks.description:
For every 25 Energy, Astra Yao will have 1 /bChord//b. While in the /bIdyllic Cadenza//b state, when Astra Yao has /bChords//b, a /bQuick Assist//b can be triggered in specific situations.

When the active character's attack hits an enemy, once per 3s.

When the active character's heavy attack hits an enemy, once per 1s.

When other squad members switch in through a /bQuick Assist//b, /bChain Attack//b, /bDefensive Assist//b, or /bEvasive Assist//b, Astra Yao will consume 25 Energy and release 1 /bTremolo//b to attack. This /bTremolo//b attack released is considered an /bEX Special Attack//b.

After triggering a /bQuick Assist//b, quickly press [ASSIST] to switch characters and trigger a /bPrecise Assist//b, causing Astra Yao to follow up with 3 /bTone Clusters//b to attack. When other squad members switch in through a /bChain Attack//b, /bDefensive Assist//b, or /bEvasive Assist//b, it will automatically trigger a /bPrecise Assist//b.

hits.name: Follow-Up Tone Cluster DMG Multiplier x3

chainAttacks.name: Tipsy Concerto (Chain Attack)
chainAttacks.description:
When a [CHAIN] is triggered, select the character to activate:

Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive Ether DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After the skill, Astra Yao enters the /bIdyllic Cadenza//b state.

ultimate.name: Fantasian Sonata (Ultimate)
ultimate.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [ULTIMATE] to activate:

Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive Ether DMG, and restoring HP to all squad members. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After the skill, Astra Yao enters the /bIdyllic Cadenza//b state. After the skill, the next two /bQuick Assist//bs will be replaced by /bChain Attacks//b.

While in the /bIdyllic Cadenza//b state, when other squad members enter the field via a /bQuick Assist//b, they will receive different buffs based on their specialty, and this effect can be triggered once every 3s for the entire squad.

Attack: The next /bQuick Assist//b heavy attack on an enemy will deal extra DMG equal to 300% of Astra Yao's ATK.

Anomaly: The next /bQuick Assist//b will have 50% increased Anomaly Buildup;

 Stun: The next /bQuick Assist//b will inflict 50% increased Daze.
